result.reason: All structural, naming, and cohesion criteria are satisfied. The module is exactly one evaluation unit: a single directory with an index.ts entry point, a dedicated award-types.ts for types, and a verb-first kebab-case logic file (pick-winners.ts) exporting a run function. The logic follows service conventions: run takes a Store, returns the domain Result type, and surfaces consumer-grade error messages for invalid input and empty qualification. There are no orphaned files — every file is reachable from index.ts through its import graph. The feature serves one coherent capability (yearly awards) and its name (awards) describes the capability, not the implementation. index.ts re-exports the entire public API and nothing else in the feature is required to be importable by outsiders.

The awards feature directory satisfies all criteria defined in the specification. It has exactly one entry point (index.ts), dedicated types file (award-types.ts), verb-first kebab-case logic file (pick-winners.ts), and follows all structural and cohesion requirements.
